title: lepechinia subhastata
intro: Lepechinia subhastata, commonly known as Mexican mint or Huacatay, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lepechinia subhastata include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and exhibit analgesic and anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of Lepechinia subhastata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
